transcript: Tonight, my friend Bella and I saw Kate Berlant perform her self titled one woman show, Kate. I had heard great things about it, and for me, it definitely lived up to the hype. The evening was an experience from start to finish, from the moment you enter the theater where you're met with a museum like exhibit all about Kate. The show itself is somewhat of a satirical take on the autobiographical one person show. And in it we learn about kate's relationship to acting both on stage and off. But at its core, I would say it's a comedy show. And I thought it had some loose similarities to the work of Bo Burnham, who evidently is the director of this piece. Overall, I thought it was super funny and really original. So I would definitely recommend. And with that, another playbill ish for my collection.
